title: Wild Horse Nine

note: A24 documentary. Fielder embeds with Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her partner Billy Evans during the 34 days before Holmes reported to federal prison; what began as a month of filming became a three-year project. Secret-screening premiere at Telluride (Sep 6, 2026); Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes; opened to ~$15.6M on 855 screens (biggest non-concert documentary opening since Fahrenheit 9/11), ~$45M domestic through Oct 25.
